name: AWS — Insider Threat: Credential Access + Defense Evasion
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = amazon_aws_raw
| filter xdm.event.type in ("GetSecretValue","GetParameter","DisableSecurityHub","BatchDisableStandards","StopConfigurationRecorder","DeleteConfigurationRecorder","UpdateConfigurationRecorder")
| filter xdm.source.ipv4 != null
| filter not (xdm.event.description contains "AWSServiceRoleFor"
       or xdm.event.description contains "InstanceProfile"
       or xdm.event.description contains "/aws-service-role/")
| bin _time span = 4h
| comp count_distinct(xdm.event.type) as distinct_ops,
       count() as total_ops,
       values(xdm.event.type) as ops
       by xdm.source.ipv4, xdm.source.user.username, _time
| filter distinct_ops >= 3 and total_ops >= 5
| fields xdm.source.ipv4, xdm.source.user.username
description: Same user performing multiple credential-access and defense-evasion ops.
alert_name: AWS — Insider Threat: Credential Access + Defense Evasion
